known_divergences_not_defects: Automatic mode selects ARMA(2,1) by an AICc-led basis where the do-file's stated rule is BIC-first, which selects ARMA(1,1). Reproducing the do-file requires manual orders or an Agent instruction.
The rolling window defaults to 20 origins against the do-file's last 20 percent, roughly 508 refits. validation_n is user-settable; this is a performance tradeoff, not a contract difference.

Under sequential estimation ARMA-only and ARMA-GARCH share the same conditional mean exactly, so their MAE and RMSE are identical and only interval width differs. Stata's joint arch command would give slightly different mean parameters. This is the already-declared directional_or_workflow_regression limit.

gates.evidence: Four defects, none visible to the deterministic suite because each needed a live provider turn or a real automatic search. The mean residuals' partial autocorrelation was computed and registered but never charted, leaving a reader following Stata's pac ehat without it; it is now a chart artifact and a gallery panel.
